GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 829.1 (23 May 49) TO/P
(SCAPIN - 2008)
APO 500
23 May 1949
MEMORANDUM FOR : JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
SUBJECT : Maintenance and Operation of Visual Signal Towers, Yokohama and Kobe, Japan.
1. The Japanese Government will, effective 1 April 1949, as required by, and subject to, the supervision of the Commanding General, Eighth Army, be responsible to fully equip, operate, and maintain visual signal towers to provide 24-hour visual signal service at Tokyo Bay and approaches, and Kobe port.
2. Direct liaison with representatives designated by the Commanding General, Eighth Army, regarding the implementation of this instruction is authorized.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
R.M. LEVY,
Colonel, AGD,
Adjutant General.
